title: The AI Capital Drain
summary: AI capital spending, sector rotation and treasury resilience.
assessment: The chip-to-software rotation is supported by subsequent prices, and the IREN put’s expiration condition succeeded despite later stock weakness. The report correctly highlights capex pressure but overgeneralizes negative free cash flow. Its flow narrative and private AI experiment require more evidence.

claims.claim: Hormuz traffic will never fully recover.
claims.reason: “Never” cannot be established at a finite cutoff. Persistent disruption supports diversification incentives, but neither current transponder counts nor dark-traffic estimates establish the permanent level of future trade.

claims.claim: Semiconductor gains drain other asset markets.
claims.reason: Relative repricing is observable, but market-cap growth is not equal to cash inflow. Every secondary-market purchase has a seller, and simultaneous declines elsewhere do not establish direct financing flows. Fund flows and issuance are needed to test the stronger causal story.

claims.reason: Micron and cloud revenue support strong current demand, but the multi-year claim must survive capacity additions, model efficiency gains and customer returns on investment. Semiconductor revenue growth alone does not establish durable end-user profitability.

Acknowledged 50% downside also prevents treating the arithmetic as a floor.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: Match the outcome window to the instrument’s actual maturity.
A market-cap change is not a dollar-for-dollar capital flow.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
